name: Bewitching Strike
entriesHtml:
Blood Cost: 1d8

You infuse fey blood into your attack. A creature hit by this attack takes an extra 2d6 Psychic damage and must make a Wisdom saving throw. If it fails the save, you can choose one of the target's allies within 30 feet of it; the target now considers that ally as an enemy until the start of your next turn.

The Psychic damage increases to 4d6 when you reach Fighter level 18.

name: Bloodboil Strike
entriesHtml:
Blood Cost: 1d6

You infuse your attack with fiendish blood, which detonates when it mixes with another creature's blood. When you hit a creature, the target and each creature other than you in a 10-foot Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation originating from the target take 2d6 Fire damage and start burning. This damage ignores Resistance|XPHB to Fire damage.

The Fire damage increases to 4d6 when you reach Fighter level 18.

name: Constraining Strike
entriesHtml:
Blood Cost: 1d8

When this attack strikes a creature, blood tainted by oozes creates grasping and sharp tendrils of blood, which wrap around the target. The target takes an extra 2d6 Acid damage, it has Disadvantage|XPHB on its next attack roll, and it must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 2d6 Acid damage the first time on each of its turns that it moves 5 feet or more without teleporting. A creature can use an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your Blood Strike save DC, removing the tendrils and ending the effect on itself or another creature within its reach on a success. Otherwise, the tendrils last for 1 minute or until you use this option again.

Both Acid damages increase to 4d6 when you reach Fighter level 18.

name: Exiling Strike
entriesHtml:
Blood Cost: 1d10

You use celestial blood to try to temporarily banish your target to a harmless location in the Celestial Plane. A creature hit by the attack must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be banished. While banished in this way, its Speed|XPHB is 0 and it has the Incapacitated condition. At the end of its next turn, the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

When you reach Fighter level 18, the target also takes 2d6 Radiant damage when the attack hits it.

name: Hunting Strike
entriesHtml:
Blood Cost: 1d4

Using ancient bestial blood, you grant your strikes unparalleled precision. Your next attack roll ignores benefits to Armor Class|XPHB granted by Shields, armor, or magical effects, such as the Shield or Mage Armor spells. When you hit a creature with this attack, it takes an extra 1d6 Slashing damage, and for the next minute, you know the target's exact location, and it doesn't gain Advantage|XPHB on attacks against you as a result of having the Invisible condition.

The Slashing damage increases to 3d6 when you reach Fighter level 18.

name: Shadowblood Strike
entriesHtml:
Blood Cost: 1d6

You weave threads of shadows from the blood of your foe, causing it to obscure the battlefield. A creature hit by the attack takes an extra 2d6 Necrotic damage, and its blood forms a dark red mist of magical Darkness spreads in a 10-foot Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation originating from the target until the start of your next turn. Darkvision can't see through this Darkness, and nonmagical light can't illuminate it.

The Necrotic damage increases to 4d6 when you reach Fighter level 18.

name: Thunderblood Strike
entriesHtml:
Blood Cost: 1d4

You imbue your attack with forceful energy drawn from the blood of giants. The attack detonates, and a creature hit by this attack takes an extra 2d6 Thunder damage and is pushed 15 feet straight away. In addition, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have the Prone condition.

The Thunder damage increases to 4d6 when you reach Fighter level 18.

name: Withering Strike
entriesHtml:
Blood Cost: 1d6

You weave cursed undead blood into your attack. A creature hit by the attack takes an extra 2d6 Necrotic damage and must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, damage dealt by the target's attacks is halved until the start of your next turn.

The Necrotic damage increases to 4d6 when you reach Fighter level 18.
